source_selection: Identical Qv5 ARC question encoding, SHA256(dataset_rev+'/'+split+'/'+ID), sort ascending; first 24 must byte-identically reproduce Qv5 source train.
cross_dataset_selection: SHA256(dataset_rev+'/validation/'+ID) order; identical single-letter A/B/C/D Qwen prompt contract; min 18/max 208 tokens; no overlap by canonical question hash with ARC source or prior ARC dev.
source_Fisher: empirical directional sensitivity E[(grad_correct_label_BF16 • native_quant_residual)^2], Q4 vs qNg64-n8; signed per-prompt BF16 backward; no per-tensor final-model intervention
primary_analysis: rank Spearman 24->64,24->128,64->128 and odd/even within; top28 source policy Jaccard, cross-dataset answer-only correct-letter NLL and four-choice accuracy
secondary_analysis: pairwise sample-level bootstrap 95 CI for Qv6_128 minus best baseline, no repeated tuning
limitations: 48 OpenBookQA validation is cross-corpus but science-domain overlap with ARC remains; not a distribution-wide OOD generalization test
All selected masks frozen source-only; held question correct labels not used for tuning
Only one model, tiny sample sizes, first-order Fisher proxy, no true Hessian and no GPU runtime dynamic bits
stop_conditions: any missing source SHA or Qv5 first24 identity mismatch
failure in audit or unsafe filesystem permissions
success_gate: NO_DEPLOY; scientific adoption only with independent later dataset/model plus cost/correctness evidence
